paite: Na melmate uh dou ding a na kuan ua, sakol, kangtalai, nou sang a mipi tamzaw na muh chiang un, na lau ding uh ahi kei. Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA na Pathian uh na kiang uah a-om hi.
heading: Kidouna Toh Kisai
english: When you go out to battle against your enemies, and see horses, chariots, and a people more numerous than you, you shall not be afraid of them; for Yahweh your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, is with you.

paite: Kidou dia na kuan dek chiang un siampu in mipi va naih henla, houpih henla, akiang uah,
english: It shall be, when you draw near to the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak to the people,

paite: "Israelte aw, za un, tu in na melmate uh dou ding na hi ua, na lungtang uh patausak kei un. Lau kei unla, ling sam kei un, amaute lauhsak in om kei un.
english: and shall tell them, “Hear, Israel, you draw near today to battle against your enemies. Don’t let your heart faint! Don’t be afraid, nor tremble, neither be scared of them;

paite: Noute hon tonpih a na melmate uh hon dousak a, hon hondam ding TOUPA na Pathian uh ahi, chi hen."
english: for Yahweh your God is he who goes with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.”

paite: Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Inn thak lam a lan nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in alan kha ding,"
heading: Mi Pawl Li Galdouna A Awlsakte
english: The officers shall speak to the people, saying, “What man is there who has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

paite: "Grephuan bawl a, agah ne nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in ane kha ding hi."
english: What man is there who has planted a vineyard, and has not used its fruit? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man use its fruit.

paite: "Zikham a kiteng nai lou na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen. Kidouna ah ava si kha dia, midang in akitenpih kha ding," chi in gen hen.
english: What man is there who has pledged to be married to a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.”

paite: Heutute'n mipite kiang ah, "Lau leh patau na om uhia? A-inn ah paikik nawn hen, a-unaute uh lungtang amah lungtang bang in azulsak kha ding," chi lai uhen.
english: The officers shall speak further to the people, and they shall say, “What man is there who is fearful and faint-hearted? Let him go and return to his house, lest his brother’s heart melt as his heart.”

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, heutute'n mipite kiang a thu agen khit un mipite makaih ding sepaih heutute asep ding uhi.
english: It shall be, when the officers have finished speaking to the people, that they shall appoint captains of armies at the head of the people.

paite: Dou ding kho kim na va tun chiang un lemna thu gen phot un.
heading: Gamdang Khopi A Galdoudan
english: When you draw near to a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace to it.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon kileppih ua, ana kihon uleh hichi ahi ding a, huai a mi om tengteng nasem dia na goih ding uh ahi dia, na nna uh asem ding uhi.
english: It shall be, if it gives you answer of peace and opens to you, then it shall be that all the people who are found therein shall become forced laborers to you, and shall serve you.

paite: Hon kileppih ut lou a, ahon na dou ding uleh umkhum un.
english: If it will make no peace with you, but will make war against you, then you shall besiege it.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na khut ua ahon piak hun chiang in pasal tengteng namsau in na that vek ding uh ahi.
english: When Yahweh your God delivers it into your hand, you shall strike every male of it with the edge of the sword;

paite: Numei leh ataneu chikchikte uh, gante leh khua a thil omte leh huai a gallak thil tengteng nou a tuam dia na lak ding uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na melmate uh a pan gallak thil na ne ding uhi.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

paite: Hiai namte khua hilou, na tenna ua kipan a kho gamla tengteng huchibang in na hih zel ding uhi.
english: Thus you shall do to all the cities which are very far off from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak hiai namte khuate zaw TOUPA na Pathian un thu ahon piak bang in ahing peuhmah bangmah na hawi ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Gam Chiam Khopite A Galdoudan
english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

paite: Hitte, Amorte, Kanaante, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste na hihmang vek ding uhi.
english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;

paite: Apathiante uh tung a ahih zel uh thilkihhuai tengteng ahon sinsaklouhna ding un hihmang vek un. Huchi lou in zaw TOUPA na Pathian tung ah thil na hihkhial kha ding uhi.
english: that they not teach you to follow all their abominations, which they have done for their gods; so would you sin against Yahweh your God.

paite: Lak tum a na dou uh khua sawtpi na um chiang un, asingte uh heipi in na phuk ding uh ahi kei; na nek ding uh ahi ngal a. Huai khopi douna a zat ding in leng na phuk ding uh ahi kei; huai gam a singte mihing hinna ahi ngal a.
heading: Sing Phuk Louh Ding
english: When you shall besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an ax against them; for you may eat of them. You shall not cut them down, for is the tree of the field man, that it should be besieged by you?

paite: Himahleh gah nei lou singte bel phuk in na hihse thei ding ua, na doute khua na lak zoh masiah uh adouna vanzat in na zang ding uhi.
english: Only the trees that you know are not trees for food, you shall destroy and cut them down. You shall build bulwarks against the city that makes war with you, until it falls.
